alive.last_commit_message:
fix(mcp-scan): rate-limit aware retry for LLM calls (#651)

Add rate-limit/transient-error aware retry for mcp-scan LLM calls via a shared `llm_retry.py` wrapper (detection of 429/42900 and Retry-After, exponential backoff, sync+async recovery), matching the semantics already used in #637.

Local verification:
- mcp-scan pytest `pytests/test_llm_retry.py`: 18 passed (detection, Retry-After extraction, backoff schedule, sync/async recovery + exhaustion, wrapped-429, header-only).
- `is_rate_limit_error` widened to catch 429s wrapped in non-API-status exceptions and 5xx-with-Retry-After.
- Isolated to mcp-scan LLM path; no regression to other modules.

NOTE: the PR body's `Fixes #123` is misattributed (issue #123 is an unrelated "change star badge" request); the actual target is the rate-limit/retry concern tracked in #633. Closing keyword intentionally omitted to avoid erroneously closing #123.

Co-authored-by: toBeYoungD <toBeYoungD@users.noreply.github.com>
